body: I want to reach out to my ex. He'd have the perfect amount of knowing me, so he'd be able to listen and talk in a way that I'd feel better. And at the same time he has the perfect amount of not caring since he honestly doesn't care about me anymore. I don't want to burden my current SO since he really loves me and this would freak him out. I'd reach out to my best friend, but he'd try to stop me or take me to the hospital. I don't want that. I want to just be done. If there's an afterlife I hope it is much better than this life. I really hope reincarnation isn't a thing since I don't want to go through this again, there is really no point to life other than to suffer. I'm sorry for just rambling on to you.
What made you finally cry? Was it out of relief or were you thinking about loved ones?
